name: Portuguese prego with green piri-piri
assumptions: Yield estimated from 2 steaks and 2 ciabatta rolls as 2 servings
Total time includes 1-2hr marinade (using 2hr max) plus ~30min active prep/cooking
Parsley listed twice but treated as one herb with stalks separated
Vinegar assumed to be sherry or wine vinegar based on context
Jalapeno treated as green piri-piri style pepper
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, nuts, peanuts, soy or sesame ingredients listed
All ingredients screened conservatively for allergens and diets
instructions:
STEP 1

Rub the garlic over the steaks then put in a sandwich bag and tip in the olive oil, sherry vinegar and parsley stalks. Smoosh everything together, then use a rolling pin to bash the steaks a few times. Leave for 1-2 hours.

STEP 2

To make the sauce, put all the ingredients into a blender with 1 tbsp water and whizz until as smooth as possible. This will make more than you’ll need for the recipe but will keep for a week in an airtight jar.

STEP 3

Heat a griddle or frying pan to high. Brush away the garlic and parsley stalks from the steaks and season well. Sear the steaks for 2 minutes on each side then rest on a plate. Put the ciabatta halves onto the plate, toasted-side down, to soak up any juices.

STEP 4

Slice the steaks then stuff into the rolls with the green sauce and rocket.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 small clove garlic, peeled, ~3g edible portion

ingredients.name: Beef Fillet
ingredients.assumptions: 2 small beef fillet steaks; typical small fillet steak ~150g each, raw weight

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons olive oil; standard 15ml per tbsp, density ~0.92g/ml

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon sherry vinegar (or similar wine vinegar); standard 15ml tbsp, mostly water with low nutrients

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Parsley stalks only (from 1 small bunch total); ~5g edible stalks used for marinade

ingredients.name: Ciabatta
ingredients.assumptions: 2 ciabatta rolls; typical 100g each, as used for sandwiches

ingredients.name: Rocket
ingredients.assumptions: 2 handfuls rocket/arugula; typical small handful ~20g each, fresh edible weight

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: Small bunch fresh basil leaves; ~25g edible leaves only

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Small bunch fresh parsley leaves; ~25g edible leaves only (separate from stalks in pos 5)

ingredients.name: Jalapeno
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium fresh jalapeño pepper, ~45g whole trimmed weight with seeds

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon vinegar (for sauce); standard 15ml tbsp, similar to pos 4

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 spring onions, chopped; typical 15g each trimmed

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar; standard 4g per tsp, so ~2g total
